review_scope: Single independent factual whole-batch web review of the complete frozen proposal; all43 items,41 new nodes,167 unique edges and188 alias keys. No candidate authoring, installation, curated-round or hidden-target approval.
rubric_sections: CRITIQUE_RUBRIC.md A3/A4/A7 and applicable F source checks; this is shared-guess vocabulary, not a new curated Cald target batch

method.fresh_lexical_check: All43 live selected DEX/DOOM3 definition IDs, exact heads, authorities and paradigms agree with the proposal; homograph numbering is compared within each dictionary, not between dictionaries.
method.secondary_source_checks: All87 distinct proposed non-DEX URLs attempted; all item senses and claims independently checked through Romanian article bodies, primary PDFs, and explicitly noted indexed primary passages. Two corrections below repair a stale evidence URL and an incorrectly attributed plant-root passage.
method.mechanical_checks: 229 unique retained normalized input keys; existing owners preserved; all41 new concepts satisfy aggregate4–8 neighbors,≥2 old,≥2 same-category and≤2 batch; Versant→Pantă emitted once; held IDs absent.
source_access_notes: Direct access to the Brumă physics textbook returned404; its indexed primary p.26 passage was read and corroborates crystals on grass after nocturnal cooling.
The Nistru management PDF timed out directly; its indexed primary wetland/vegetation passage was read.
The Carpathian avalanche report had a TLS hostname error directly; its indexed primary winter/Carpathian passage was read.
Gardena lawn-special part2 returned404 directly but its full Romanian article body was available through the web reader, including root attachment and garden use.
The university anatomy PDF reader failed; the indexed primary printed-p.219 figure caption explicitly identifies Typha latifolia roots and rhizomes.
Secetă old Gardena URL was unavailable directly and through the web reader; a current same-publisher primary source is specified in its modify verdict.
